_comment: The prompts app-check runs. Each 'data' prompt is built once per target in 'targets'; each
'description' prompt once, as its own 'target', because class discovery does not depend on the
target. {repo} is replaced with the repository root.
'expect' lists the classes a description prompt should find: each entry is one class, given as
the names that would count for it, so ['Teacher', 'Instructor'] is satisfied by either.

description.command: build app: a clinic that books patients with doctors
build app: a library that lends books to members
build app: a car rental company that rents vehicles to customers
build app: a school that enrols students in courses taught by teachers
build app: a gym that sells memberships to members and runs fitness classes
